newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-ENTREPRENEUR OUT OF IRISH DERBY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ENTREPRENEUR OUT OF IRISH DERBY.

text.p: Entrepreneur, beaten favourite in the Epsom Derby two weeks ago, has been pulled out of Sunday's Irish Derby, trainer Michael Stoute said on Monday.
"He returned from Epsom with a right-side hamstring strain," Stoute said.
"Intensive physiotherapy enabled him to resume cantering on June 17, but a weekend gallop determined that he would not be at peak fitness for the Curragh."
Entrepreneur was hot favourite for the Epsom Derby but finished a disappointing fourth.
